_meta.title: Concentration camps, Nazi camps and ghettos (Wikidata)
_meta.measures: Every Wikidata item that is an instance of 'concentration camp' (Q152081) or any subclass (Nazi concentration camp, extermination camp, subcamp, labour camp, clandestine detention centres, etc.), plus every 'ghetto in Nazi-occupied Europe' (Q2583015). nazi_related=true marks Nazi-system sites (Nazi classes, EHRI camp code, or Nazi operator/country); other records are camps elsewhere (e.g. Argentina, Uruguay, Chile detention centres, Japanese camps in the Dutch East Indies, NKVD camps).
_meta.notes: Deaths are recorded for few items (field deaths). EHRI codes are identifiers of the European Holocaust Research Infrastructure camp list.
